instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: Okay, so in a previous trial, you created using one green brick with a short side facing you, a red column brick on its back two rows, and then another green brick that was on top of the red column brick and vertically aligned with the bottom green brick. So it would look like the letter C if you look at it from the left. So this is the same construction, but now instead of putting it on the left side of the 2x2 grid, you're going to place it on the right side so that still when you look at it from the left, it will look like a letter C.

assumptions: The 'C' shape is formed by two horizontal green blocks and one vertical red block.
The instruction 'one green brick with a short side facing you' implies the green block has axis=x (dimensions 4x1x2).
The instruction 'a red column brick on its back two rows' means the red block's z-extent aligns with the bottom green block's z-extent.
The instruction 'vertically aligned with the bottom green brick' means the top green block's footprint is directly above the bottom green block's footprint.
The instruction 'on the right side of the 2x2 grid' means the vertical red block is placed in the right column (x=[2,4]), and the horizontal green blocks span the full x-width of the grid (x=[0,4]).
The C shape is centered in the z-dimension of the grid (z=[1,3]).
evidence: one green brick with a short side facing you
a red column brick on its back two rows
another green brick that was on top of the red column brick and vertically aligned with the bottom green brick
it would look like the letter C if you look at it from the left
now instead of putting it on the left side of the 2x2 grid, you're going to place it on the right side
so that still when you look at it from the left, it will look like a letter C
